key_decisions.rationale: Preserves church, two roles, all five names, origins, nickname, and Herod relationship.
key_decisions.before: In the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen, who had been raised with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
key_decisions.after: In the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas; Simeon called Niger; Lucius of Cyrene; Manaen, a close companion of Herod the tetrarch; and Saul.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now there were in Antioch, in the church that was there, prophets and teachers: Barnabas, and Simeon who was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps worship, fasting, Spirit speech, two names, separation, work, and prior call.
key_decisions.before: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
key_decisions.after: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart Barnabas and Saul for me for the work to which I have called them.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And while they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps extent, destination, ethnicity, name, and two negative roles.
key_decisions.before: After traveling through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus who was a magician and false prophet.
key_decisions.after: After traveling across the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus who was a magician and false prophet.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And going through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain man, a magician, a Jewish false prophet, whose name was Bar-Jesus,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps translated name, opposition, official, and purpose.
key_decisions.before: But Elymas the magician—that is how his name is translated—opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
key_decisions.after: But Elymas the magician—for that is how his name is translated—opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is translated) was opposing them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps severe address, deceit, familial insult, righteousness contrast, and road image.
key_decisions.before: and said, “You are full of every kind of deceit and fraud, son of the devil and enemy of all righteousness! Will you never stop twisting the Lord’s straight ways?
key_decisions.after: and said, “You are full of every kind of deceit and fraud, you son of the devil and enemy of everything right! Will you never stop twisting the Lord’s straight ways?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and said, “O full of all deceit and all fraud, son of the devil, enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease perverting the straight ways of the Lord?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves divine-hand image, temporary blindness, sun, immediacy, darkness, and dependence.
key_decisions.before: Now look—the Lord’s hand is against you. You will be blind and unable to see the sun for a time.” Immediately mist and darkness fell over him, and he went around looking for people to lead him by the hand.
key_decisions.after: Now look—the Lord’s hand is against you. You will be blind and unable to see the sun for a time.” Immediately mist and darkness fell over him, and he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind and not seeing the sun for a time.” And immediately mist and darkness fell upon him, and going about he was seeking people to lead him by the hand.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul’s emerging leadership, route, John’s departure, and destination.
key_decisions.before: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and returned to Jerusalem.
key_decisions.after: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and returned to Jerusalem.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now Paul and those with him set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia, but John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves removal, appointment, testimony, lineage, heart, and comprehensive obedience.

key_decisions.after: After removing him, God raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart, who will do everything I want.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And having removed him, he raised up David for them as king, to whom also he bore witness and said, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps race-course image, identity question, denial, coming one, and sandal humility.

key_decisions.after: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one. But look—one is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’

key_decisions.rationale: Uses inclusive address while retaining Abrahamic descent, God-fearers, salvation, and divine sending.
key_decisions.before: “Brothers and sisters, children of Abraham’s family, and those among you who fear God: the word of this salvation has been sent to us.
key_decisions.after: “Brothers and sisters, children of Abraham’s family, and those among you who fear God, this message of salvation has been sent to us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Men, brothers, sons of the family of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, to us the word of this salvation has been sent.

key_decisions.rationale: Clarifies Jesus as referent and preserves ignorance, weekly reading, judgment, and ironic fulfillment.
key_decisions.before: The people living in Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus or understand the voices of the prophets read every Sabbath, yet by condemning him they fulfilled those words.
key_decisions.after: The residents of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus or understand the words of the prophets read every Sabbath. Yet by condemning him, they fulfilled those words.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For those dwelling in Jerusalem and their rulers, not recognizing him nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fulfillment, tree image, descent, and burial.
key_decisions.before: When they had completed everything written about him, they took him down from the tree and placed him in a tomb.
key_decisions.after: When they had carried out everything written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when they had carried out all that had been written about him, taking him down from the tree, they laid him in a tomb.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fulfillment, generational link, raising Jesus, psalm number, sonship, and the source’s birth image.
key_decisions.before: God has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising Jesus, just as it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are my Son; today I have begotten you.’
key_decisions.after: God has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second psalm: ‘You are my Son; today I have begotten you.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: God has fulfilled to us their children by raising Jesus, as also it is written in the second Psalm, ‘You are my Son; today I have begotten you.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps resurrection, permanence, decay, divine quotation, holiness, certainty, and David.

key_decisions.after: God raised him from the dead, never again to return to decay. He expressed it this way: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps universal believer, justification, comprehensive scope, and contrast with Mosaic law.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps severe address, commands, divine work, timing, repetition, and disbelief.
